frames.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production sprite W1 for Fenna fox garden walk, square canvas, flat uniform chroma green #00ff00 background. References: image 1 canonical Fenna identity, image 2 her garden water G1 for exact proportions/colors/scale, image 3 approved Miffy W1 for leg/arm phase only. Replace rabbit identity with Fenna. Calm cheerful right-facing profile fox: same large rounded orange head, triangular ears with cream interiors, one black eye, short pointed cream muzzle and black nose, open warm-ochre vest, blue neckerchief, cream tummy, cream feet with two toe lines, bushy orange tail with cream tip trailing left. Carry upright BLUE watering can in bent FRONT paw, spout right, no water. Free far arm swings backward left.
W1 RIGHT FOOT CONTACT: near/right leg reaches boldly forward toward right, heel planted on ground, toes slightly up; far/left leg reaches back toward left, toes down and heel raised. Broad clear stride with separated feet, children's-book gentle gait. Full body and complete tail/can uncropped. Keep same apparent scale as water G1: if canvas 627px, head top about y82 and body/can center x320, soles y570, can ends x490. Head width about 250px with ears, torso extends y335..520, head/body proportions unchanged from G1. Profile replaces front view, no size jump. Can carried same y420..515 like Miffy, not pouring. Thin restrained smooth black outlines, flat orange and ochre colors, light subtle texture as reference. No flower, grass, floor, shadow, text, border, extra limbs, droplets. Only one sprite.
